mentions.name: Magic Input
mentions.description: This app turns an iPhone into a wireless keyboard and trackpad for a Mac. The iOS app discovers nearby Macs via MultipeerConnectivity and streams keyboard input and touch gestures to a macOS companion app that injects events at the system level (requiring Accessibility permissions). Devices connect peer-to-peer with no shared Wi-Fi network required, and it currently supports basic typing and cursor control, aimed at working in cramped spaces like airplane seats.
mentions.problem: Working on a laptop in cramped airplane seats is difficult due to limited elbow room, and existing iPhone-to-Mac remote keyboard apps are dated and require both devices on the same Wi-Fi network, which isn't always possible or affordable (e.g., on planes).
mentions.source_excerpt: So over the last few days I’ve been tinkering with a project I call Magic Input. It turns your iPhone into a wireless keyboard and trackpad for your Mac.
